meta.name: notaire
meta.description:
Notaire IA pour le droit immobilier, les successions, les donations, le droit de la famille
et le droit des sociétés en France. Copilote juridique pour la préparation d'actes, le conseil
patrimonial, les calculs de frais et la vérification de conformité.

Couvre le calcul des frais de notaire (DMTO, émoluments, débours, CSI), la plus-value
immobilière, les droits de succession et donation, le démembrement, les contrats de mariage,
les PACS, les SCI, et la rédaction de projets d'actes (compromis, statuts, testaments).

Triggers: notaire, frais de notaire, acte de vente, compromis, succession, donation, héritage, testament, PACS, contrat de mariage, SCI, plus-value immobilière, droits de mutation, DMTO, usufruit, nue-propriété, partage successoral, réserve héréditaire, viager, donation-partage, diagnostics immobilier, droit de préemption, acte notarié, droit immobilier

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 计算法国房产交易与继承相关税费并准备法律文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要处理法国房产买卖、继承或捐赠的法律与税务事宜。
copy.tagline_en: Calculate French real estate and inheritance taxes and prepare legal documents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle French real estate transactions, inheritance, or donation legal and tax matters.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成法国公证事务助手，能计算公证费、遗产税、赠与税，起草买卖合同、遗嘱、PACS 协议等法律文书，并检查合规性。
howto.when: 当你提到“公证费”“买卖合同”“继承”“赠与”“遗嘱”“PACS”“SCI”等关键词，或要求计算房产交易费用、起草法律文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我算一下巴黎一套30万欧元公寓的公证费。
say.note: Claude 会调用 DMTO 税率和收费表计算明细。

say.text: 起草一份简单的赠与合同，赠与人是我父亲，受赠人是我。
say.note: Claude 会使用捐赠模板生成草案。

say.text: 继承一套房产，父母双亡，我是独生子女，需要交多少遗产税？
say.note: Claude 会计算扣除免税额后的应纳税额。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a French notarial assistant: it can calculate notary fees, inheritance and gift taxes, draft sale agreements, wills, PACS agreements, and check legal compliance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "notaire", "frais de notaire", "acte de vente", "succession", "donation", "testament", "PACS", "SCI", or ask for fee calculations or legal document drafting.

say_en.text: Calculate the notary fees for a €300,000 apartment in Paris.
say_en.note: Claude will compute using DMTO rates and fee schedules.

say_en.text: Draft a simple donation contract from my father to me.
say_en.note: Claude will use the donation template to generate a draft.

say_en.text: I inherit a house as the only child; how much inheritance tax do I owe?
say_en.note: Claude will calculate the tax after applicable allowances.
